blockers.root_cause: The evidence and Stage A lifecycle had not been made an explicitly one-way record graph with a separately hashed admission record.

remediation.model: Immutable evidence record first, then separate append-only Stage A admission record referencing mapping_record_id and full evidence-record SHA-256.

lineage.supersede: Requires an existing successor record hash.
lineage.revoke: Has no successor and leaves historical bytes readable but inactive.
lineage.rollback_reactivate: References an existing prior valid record and has no successor; it recomputes active state without mutation.

acceptance_checks: Evidence schema has no Stage A back-reference.
Stage A references evidence ID and full evidence hash.
Stage A schema represents both ADMISSION_READY and fail-closed ADMISSION_NOT_READY outcomes.
The verifier requires the identity-basis projection to equal the operative evidence fields byte-for-byte.
Reference graph has an explicit creation topological order.
SUPERSEDE successor requirement and REVOKE/ROLLBACK no-successor rules are defined.
No historical record is edited, deleted, or rewritten.

blockers.root_cause: The identity field set, canonicalization details, metadata exclusions, and duplicate/collision outcomes were not complete and internally fixed.

remediation.duplicate_rule: Same ID and byte-identical full evidence record is an idempotent duplicate.
remediation.reuse_mismatch_rule: Same ID with changed identity or full bytes fails closed as MAPPING_RECORD_ID_REUSE_OR_IDENTITY_MISMATCH.
remediation.collision_rule: Distinct identity bases with the same SHA-256 fail closed as MAPPING_RECORD_HASH_COLLISION.

acceptance_checks: Schema constants match the pinned canonicalization profile.
Identity basis has exactly eight named members in the fixed contract order.
No timestamp, random, sequence, process, or reviewer preference enters identity.
Independent ID and full-record hash recomputation is required.
Duplicate, reuse mismatch, and collision handling are fail-closed.

blockers.root_cause: Stage B did not normatively bind the exact existing R8 packet, R5/R8 candidate object identity, target tuple, and complete candidate pointer set.

packet_identity.hash_bytes: Exact UTF-8 bytes of one R8 JSONL record without BOM and excluding only its LF line terminator.

remediation.target_linkage: Stage B target must equal evidence and packet target byte-for-byte.

pointer_set.completeness: Exact full set; no hidden pruning, truncation, addition, deletion, or normalization.
pointer_set.ordering: UTF-16 code-unit pointer order after NFC validation

remediation.stage_a_gate: Stage B is permitted only after independent Stage A ADMISSION_READY.

acceptance_checks: No invented packet ID is required.
R5 and R8 candidate object identities are explicit and equal by recomputation.
Target and complete pointer-set equality are explicit.
Any linkage mismatch fails closed with the exact disposition.
Human pin action remains a separate record and no selection is automatic.
